# TypeScript API reference

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Every public type in the TypeScript library, grouped by what it is for. Each page lists its constructors, properties and methods with signatures, and an example where one exists. The .NET library has the same pages: see the [.NET API reference](../dotnet/README.md).

## Document

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`Document`](document.md) | High-level entry point for creating PDF documents. |
| [`BonniePdfError`](bonnie-pdf-error.md) | Base type for errors raised by BonniePDF itself (content that cannot be encoded, a definition that cannot be read, SVG the profile does not support, tree operations that would produce invalid output), as opposed to error |
| [`Border`](border.md) | Represents border widths for the four sides of an element. |
| [`BorderColors`](border-colors.md) | Stores the colors of an element’s four borders. |
| [`BorderStyle`](border-style.md) | Provides semantic border width presets for common use cases. |
| [`Color`](color.md) | Represents an RGB color with values ranging from 0 to 255. |
| [`ColorPalette`](color-palette.md) | Tailwind v4 colour ramps addressed by shade, e.g. `ColorPalette.red[500]`. |
| [`DiagnosticCategory`](diagnostic-category.md) | The subsystem a diagnostic came from, such as fonts, images, encryption or tagging. |
| [`DiagnosticsCollector`](diagnostics-collector.md) | Collects diagnostics during PDF generation. |
| [`DiagnosticSeverity`](diagnostic-severity.md) | Structured, non-throwing report of a recoverable issue encountered while generating a PDF - most commonly a font that couldn't be loaded, an image that failed to decode, or a subset operation that fell back to embedding  |
| [`ElementCycleError`](element-cycle-error.md) | Thrown when an element contains itself, directly or through its descendants. |
| [`formatNumber`](format-number.md) | Formats a number with the portable G, F, N, or P grammar, with optional prefix and positive sign. |
| [`HorizontalAlignment`](horizontal-alignment.md) | Defines horizontal alignment within an available layout region. |
| [`Hyperlink`](hyperlink.md) | Renders linked text that opens a URI or navigates to another page. |
| [`HyperlinkOptions`](hyperlink-options.md) | Options for `Hyperlink`. |
| [`IDiagnostic`](i-diagnostic.md) | One recoverable issue reported while generating a PDF. |
| [`ImageDecodeError`](image-decode-error.md) | Thrown when image bytes cannot be decoded: the compressed pixel data is corrupt or truncated, or the image is larger than `ImageLoader.maxPixels`. |
| [`MissingGlyphException`](missing-glyph-exception.md) | Raised when text uses a character that no registered font can draw and the document's `settings.missingGlyphs` is `'throw'`. |
| [`OversizedContentError`](oversized-content-error.md) | Raised when content that cannot split across pages is taller than a page and the document's `settings.oversizedContent` is `'throw'`. |
| [`PageOrientation`](page-orientation.md) | Provides the supported portrait and landscape page orientations. |
| [`Palette`](palette.md) | A single colour ramp: each shade stop mapped to its `Color`. |
| [`PaletteName`](palette-name.md) | The names of the available palettes (`'slate'`, `'red'`, …). |
| [`PdfAResourceIssue`](pdf-a-resource-issue.md) | A PDF/A problem found among the resources a document uses. |
| [`PdfAResourceIssueCode`](pdf-a-resource-issue-code.md) | The kind of PDF/A resource problem: a standard font left unembedded, transparency that was flattened, or a PNG soft mask that was flattened. |
| [`PdfAResourceIssueSeverity`](pdf-a-resource-issue-severity.md) | Whether a PDF/A resource problem is `'blocking'` (the conformance claim cannot be made) or `'mitigated'` (handled, with a possible loss of fidelity). |
| [`Point`](point.md) | Represents a two-dimensional coordinate. |
| [`SectionLink`](section-link.md) | Renders linked text that navigates to a named section in the document. |
| [`SectionLinkOptions`](section-link-options.md) | Options for `SectionLink`. |
| [`Shade`](shade.md) | The eleven Tailwind shade stops, lightest (50) to darkest (950). |
| [`SHADES`](shades.md) | The canonical shade stops in order, lightest to darkest. |
| [`Size`](size.md) | Represents a two-dimensional width and height. |
| [`SnapshotPage`](snapshot-page.md) | One rendered page's size and backdrop facts. |
| [`SvgRasterizer`](svg-rasterizer.md) | Renders a self-contained SVG document to PNG bytes, at the pixel size its `width` and `height` attributes give. |
| [`Thickness`](thickness.md) | Stores the top, right, bottom, and left values of padding or a margin. |
| [`Unit`](unit.md) | Measurement units for lengths and dimensions. |
| [`Units`](units.md) | Converts measurements between points and common physical units. |
| [`VerticalAlignment`](vertical-alignment.md) | Defines vertical alignment within an available layout region. |

| [`TextBlockOptions`](text-block-options.md) | Options for `TextBlock`. |
| [`TextElementOptions`](text-element-options.md) | Options shared by every text element (`TextBlock`, `Heading`, `PageNumberOf`, the list types). |
| [`TextSpanOptions`](text-span-options.md) | Options for `TextSpan`. |
| [`TextStyleOptions`](text-style-options.md) | Options for constructing a `TextStyle`. |
| [`translate`](translate.md) | Creates a native translate wrapper. |

## Tables

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`Table`](table.md) | Lays out rows and cells with column sizing, headers, footers, borders, and pagination. |
| [`Grid`](grid.md) | Builds a table from a rectangular collection of cells. |
| [`TableCell`](table-cell.md) | Contains the content and styling for one table cell. |
| [`TableRow`](table-row.md) | Contains the cells and styling for one table row. |

## Charts

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`AreaChart`](area-chart.md) | Renders one or more data series as filled areas against Cartesian axes. |

| [`AxisOptionsOptions`](axis-options-options.md) | Options for `AxisOptions`. |
| [`BarChart`](bar-chart.md) | Renders a data series as vertical or horizontal bars. |

| [`ChartBarStyle`](chart-bar-style.md) | Explicit settings override the theme, including a corner radius of zero. |
| [`ChartBarStyleOptions`](chart-bar-style-options.md) | Optional value-end rounding and opaque linear fill. |

| [`ChartBaseOptions`](chart-base-options.md) | Options common to every chart. |

| [`ChartDataPointOptions`](chart-data-point-options.md) | Options for `ChartDataPoint`. |

| [`ChartElementOptions`](chart-element-options.md) | Options for `ChartElement`. |

| [`ChartSeriesStyleOptions`](chart-series-style-options.md) | Options for `ChartSeriesStyle`. |
| [`DotPlotChart`](dot-plot-chart.md) | Renders each data value as a dot positioned along a Cartesian scale. |
| [`DotPlotChartOptions`](dot-plot-chart-options.md) | Options for `DotPlotChart`. |

| [`GroupedBarChartElementOptions`](grouped-bar-chart-element-options.md) | Options for `GroupedBarChartElement`. |
| [`GroupedBarChartOptions`](grouped-bar-chart-options.md) | Options for `GroupedBarChart`. |

| [`LollipopChartOptions`](lollipop-chart-options.md) | Options for `LollipopChart`. |

| [`PieChartOptions`](pie-chart-options.md) | Options for `PieChart`. |

| [`toChartDecimal`](to-chart-decimal.md) | The shortest decimal that round-trips `value`. |

## Drawing

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`applyPaintTransform`](apply-paint-transform.md) | Apply a transform to a point. |
| [`embeddedFontFamily`](embedded-font-family.md) | Private CSS family name for an embedded font subset. |
| [`FillRule`](fill-rule.md) | How overlapping sub-paths are filled: `'nonzero'` or `'evenodd'`. |
| [`GradientStop`](gradient-stop.md) | A colour at a position along a gradient. |
| [`ICanvas`](i-canvas.md) | A drawing surface that elements render onto. |
| [`IDENTITY_PAINT_TRANSFORM`](identity-paint-transform.md) | The transform that changes nothing. |
| [`invertPaintTransform`](invert-paint-transform.md) | The inverse, or `null` when the transform is not invertible. |
| [`isIdentityPaintTransform`](is-identity-paint-transform.md) | Returns `true` for the identity transform, and for `undefined`. |
| [`LinearGradientPaint`](linear-gradient-paint.md) | Paints an area with colors interpolated along a straight line. |
| [`LineCap`](line-cap.md) | How the ends of an open line are drawn: `'butt'`, `'round'` or `'square'`. |
| [`LineJoin`](line-join.md) | How corners between segments are drawn: `'miter'`, `'round'` or `'bevel'`. |
| [`mapPaintBox`](map-paint-box.md) | The axis-aligned box containing the four mapped corners of a box. |
| [`Paint`](paint.md) | How an area is filled: a `SolidPaint`, a `LinearGradientPaint` or a `RadialGradientPaint`. |
| [`PaintTransform`](paint-transform.md) | An affine transform describing a paint's own coordinate space. |
| [`paintTransformDeterminant`](paint-transform-determinant.md) | Determinant; zero means the transform collapses paint space and paints nothing. |
| [`RadialGradientPaint`](radial-gradient-paint.md) | Paints an area with colors interpolated outward from a center point. |
| [`Shapes`](shapes.md) | Adds common geometric shapes to the current canvas path. |
| [`SolidPaint`](solid-paint.md) | Paints an area with a single color. |
| [`StrokeStyle`](stroke-style.md) | How a path is outlined. |

## Typography

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`DocumentFontFace`](document-font-face.md) | One font file in a document, identified by family, weight and italic. |
| [`DocumentFontOptions`](document-font-options.md) | Options for `DocumentFonts.add`. |
| [`DocumentFonts`](document-fonts.md) | The fonts that belong to one document. |
| [`FallbackFont`](fallback-font.md) | A registered font available to the glyph-fallback chain. |
| [`FontFamilyDefinition`](font-family-definition.md) | Defines the TTF file paths for each variant of a custom font family. |
| [`FontFamilyResolver`](font-family-resolver.md) | Resolves a font family name + weight + italic to the actual PDF font name or TTF file path. |
| [`FontManager`](font-manager.md) | Registers font bytes and resolves font families, weights, fallbacks, and bundled substitutes. |
| [`FontMetrics`](font-metrics.md) | Provides font metrics for calculating text width in PDF documents. |
| [`FontRegistrationOptions`](font-registration-options.md) | Optional names supplied when registering in-memory font bytes. |
| [`FontWeight`](font-weight.md) | Font weight values following the CSS/OpenType weight scale. |
| [`loadFontFromUrl`](load-font-from-url.md) | Asynchronously fetches a TrueType font from a URL (browser) or file path (Node), parses it, and registers it so subsequent synchronous layout + rendering passes can use it without further async work. |
| [`StandardFonts`](standard-fonts.md) | Provides the names of the 14 standard Type 1 PDF fonts. |

## Configuration

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`DocumentSettings`](document-settings.md) | Configures document-wide page, output, security, accessibility, and metadata behavior. |
| [`DocumentMetadata`](document-metadata.md) | Contains descriptive metadata written to the PDF information and XMP records. |
| [`AccessibilityMode`](accessibility-mode.md) | Accessibility / tagged-PDF conformance mode for the document. |

| [`addBookmarks`](add-bookmarks.md) | Adds multiple bookmarks to the document. |

| [`asPdf20`](as-pdf20.md) | Sets the PDF version to 2.0. |
| [`asPdfA`](as-pdf-a.md) | Selects PDF/A-2b archival mode. |
| [`asPdfA4`](as-pdf-a4.md) | Enables PDF/A-4 baseline archival mode. |
| [`BaselineAlignmentInput`](baseline-alignment-input.md) | A `BaselineAlignment` value or one of its string spellings (`BaselineAlignmentToken`). |
| [`BaselineAlignmentToken`](baseline-alignment-token.md) | String spellings accepted wherever a `BaselineAlignment` is expected: `'baseline'` \| `'superscript'` \| `'subscript'`. |
| [`BonniePdfSettings`](bonnie-pdf-settings.md) | Process-wide library settings. |
| [`BookmarkItem`](bookmark-item.md) | Represents one bookmark and its optional child bookmarks in the document outline. |
| [`BookmarkItemOptions`](bookmark-item-options.md) | Options for `BookmarkItem`. |
| [`BorderInput`](border-input.md) | Every form a border may be written as. |
| [`BorderObject`](border-object.md) | A border written as widths plus an optional colour. |

| [`ColorToken`](color-token.md) | A palette token: `<family>-<shade>`, e.g. `'slate-800'`. |

| [`ContentDirectionInput`](content-direction-input.md) | Accepted paragraph and layout directions. |

| [`HexColor`](hex-color.md) | A hex colour. |

| [`PageModeToken`](page-mode-token.md) | String spellings accepted wherever a `PageMode` is expected: `'use-none'` \| `'use-outlines'` \| `'use-thumbs'` \| `'full-screen'` \| `'use-oc'` \| `'use-attachments'`. |
